Many of the distributions in this course,
such as the [Bernoulli](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-bernoulli),
[Poisson](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/distributions.html#def-poisson)
and [Normal](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-normal) distributions,
share one algebraic form for their
[probability mass function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pmf)
or [density](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf).
Distributions with that form are called an [exponential family](#def-exponential-family),
and they share properties that make estimation easier.
This page defines the form and its [natural parameter](#def-natural-parameter),
and checks the form for the [Poisson distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/distributions.html#def-poisson) on data.
